senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be heavy, weighty, important; cmp. יָקַר.

units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:1">Ab. IV, 1</cite> <he>איזהו מכובד המְכַבֵּד וכ׳</he> who will be honored? He who honors men.

<cite ref="Shabbat 113b:12">Sabb. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>ר״י קרי למאניה מְכַבְּדוֹתַי</he> Rabbi Joh. called his garments ‘my honorers’; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 91b">B. Kam. 91ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 94a:16">Snh. 94ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 46b:15">Ber. 46ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אין מְכַבְּדִין וכ׳</he> we must not show honors (saying, ‘you go first’) on highroads &c. Part. pass. <he>מְכוּבָּד</he>, pl. <he>מְכוּבָּדִים</he>, <he>מְכוּבָּדִין</he>. Ab. l. c., v. supra. Ib. 6 <he>כל המכבד … גופו מ׳ על וכ׳</he> he who honors the Law, will himself be honored of men.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:3">Ab. Zar. III, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00421"><he>בָּזָה</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (cmp. אִיקְרָא, יְקַר) to offer a gift. Tanḥ. Vayḥi 13 שמְכַבְּדִין מפירותיהם וכ׳ they offer of their fruits to kings; Gen. R. s. 99, end והם מבכרין (corr. acc.); a. e.
[to make look respectable,] to sweep, adjust the room.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 8:4">Ber. VIII, 4</cite> <he>מכבדיו את הבית וכ׳</he> (after meal) the room is put in order (the crumbs swept), and then &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 2:7">Bets. II, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Beitzah 22b:9">22ᵇ</cite>) <he>מכבדין בין המטות</he> (Bab. ed. <he>בית המטות</he>) (on Holy Days) you may sweep between the dining couches (the dining room); Y. ib. II, 61ᶜ bot.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 5:5">Tam. V, 5</cite> <he>היה מְכַבְּדָן לאמה</he> one swept them (the coals) into the duct; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 8:4">Mikv. VIII, 4</cite> <he>כִּיבְּדָֹה את</he>, <he>הבית</he>, v. <cite ref="B00753"><he>בַּיִת</he></cite> 6.—[Ruth R. end <he>וכבד</he> some ed., read: <he>וכָבַר</he>.]

senses.gloss: to be honored; to pride, exalt one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:5">Gen. R. s. 1</cite> <he>כל המִתְכַּבֵּד בקלון וכ׳</he> whoever elevates himself at the expense of his neighbor’s degradation, has no share in the world to come; Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᶜ.
<cite ref="Megillah 28a:6">Meg. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מימי לא נִתְכַּבַּדְתִּי וכ׳</he> I never elevated myself &c.
Ber. 60ᵇ הִתְכַּבְּדוּ מכובדים be in honor dismissed, you honored ones (angels); a. e.—2) to be cleaned, swept; to be dressed, adorned.

<cite ref="Pesachim 7a:10">Pes. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>שוקי … עשויין להתכ׳ וכ׳</he> the streets of Jerusalem used to be swept every day. Y. Nidd. I, beg. 48ᵈ <he>כמבוי שהוא מתכבד וכ׳</he> like an alley which is regularly swept and flushed. Bab.
<cite ref="Niddah 56a:75">Nidd. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>חזקתז מתכבד</he> it is presumed to be clean.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:15">Num. R. s. 13</cite> <he>לאכול ולשתות ולהתכבד</he> to eat and drink and dress. [<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:15">Tosef. Ter. X, 15</cite> <he>ליכבד</he>, read with ed. Zuck. <he>ליכבר</he>, v. <cite ref="K00074"><he>כָּבַר</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 1:2">Naz. I, 2</cite> <he>ה׳ שערו</he> if his hair is too heavy on him.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 9:8">Ex. R. s. 9</cite>; Tanḥ. Vaera 12 (play on <cite ref="K00030"><he>כָּבֵד</he></cite>, <cite ref="Exodus 7:14">Ex. VII, 14</cite>, a. <he>הִכָּבְדִי</he> XIV, 18) <he>בלשון שהִכְבֵּדְתָּ בו בלשון אני מתכבד</he> with the same expression (<cite ref="K00030"><he>כבד</he></cite>) with which thou didst make heavy (Israel’s yoke), I shall be honored; Tanḥ. ed. Bub. ib. 14 <he>שהכבדת את לבך</he> wherewith thou didst harden thy heart.

senses.gloss: to grow worse, be very sick (cmp. טָעַן II), opp. היקל.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 9:1">Snh. IX, 1</cite> <he>ה׳ ומת</he> grew worse and died; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 78b">ib. 78ᵇ</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 23">Num. R. s. 23</cite>; Tanḥ. Masʿé 13 <he>הִכְבִּידָן</he> he swept (drove) them out, v. <cite ref="M01343"><he>מַכְבֵּד</he></cite> a. <cite ref="E00622"><he>הָמַם</he></cite>.
